bihar_raw_news.title: Bihar DGP Vinay Kumar Appointed Chief Information Commissioner - Drishti IAS
bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar Prev Next Bihar DGP Vinay Kumar Appointed Chief Information Commissioner 29 Sep 2026 2 min read Why in News? 1991-batch IPS officer Vinay Kumar has taken Voluntary Retirement Scheme (VRS) from the post of Bihar Director General of Police (DGP) and has been appointed as the Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) of Bihar . Key Points Appointment: Vinay Kumar has been appointed as the Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) of Bihar . Selection: A committee headed by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary cleared Kumar’s name for the post of CIC. The post of CIC had been vacant since the tenure of senior IAS officer Tripurari Sharan ended on July 31, 2026 . DGP Additional Charge: Preeta Verma , a 1991-batch IPS officer , has been given the additional charge of Bihar DGP until a full-fledged police chief is appointed. She is the first woman IPS officer to hold the post of acting DGP in Bihar. DGP Selection Process: The Bihar Home Department has initiated the process of preparing a panel of 20 IPS officers , which will be sent to the UPSC . After examining the officers based on seniority, service records and remaining tenure , the UPSC will send a list of three officers to the Bihar Government. Final Selection: The Chief Minister will select the new Bihar DGP from the three officers shortlisted by the UPSC . Chief Information Commissioner (CIC): Establishment: CIC is an independent statutory body established under the Right to Information Act, 2005 Composition: The CIC consists of one Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) and up to 10 Information Commissioners (ICs) . Tenure: The Chief Information Commissioner and Information Commissioners hold office for 3 years or until attaining 65 years of age , whichever is earlier. They are not eligible for reappointment after completing their term. bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar's UGMAC (Under Graduate Medical Admission Counselling) board has opened Round 3 counselling for NEET UG 2026 candidates who did not participate in earlier rounds or did not submit their application and fees in time. This is your chance to apply for MBBS, BDS, and veterinary/fisheries courses in Bihar government and private colleges based on vacant seats left after Round 2 counselling (which ended 29 September 2026). Online registration and choice filling will start on 1 October 2026. If you qualified NEET UG 2026 and are not yet admitted to any medical college in India, you are eligible to apply in this round. Round 3 counselling for Bihar MBBS/BDS opens 1 October 2026 for candidates who missed earlier rounds — check the updated seat matrix before applying. What is Round 3 Counselling and Who Should Apply Round 3 is the third and final counselling round for NEET UG 2026 candidates seeking admission to MBBS, BDS, B.V.Sc. & A.H. (veterinary), and B.F.Sc. (fisheries) courses in Bihar. It is open to candidates who either did not register at all in earlier rounds, or registered but did not submit their online application with the required counselling fee and security deposit by the deadlines set in previous advertisements. This round fills seats that remain vacant after Round 2 counselling (held 27–29 September 2026). These vacancies may arise because candidates did not accept their allotted seat, or because seats were not filled in earlier rounds. The board will upload an updated seat matrix showing exactly how many seats are available in each college and course before Round 3 registration opens. You are eligible for Round 3 if you have a valid NEET UG 2026 score, have not been admitted to any medical or dental college in India so far, and meet the eligibility criteria set out in the UGMAC 2026 prospectus. Important Dates for Round 3 The key date to remember is 1 October 2026 — this is when online registration and choice filling will begin. The notice does not specify an end date for Round 3 application submission, so you must check the board's website (bceceboard.bihar.gov.in) or the full prospectus for the exact closing date and time. Round 2 counselling was held from 27 to 29 September 2026, and the updated seat matrix showing vacancies will be published before Round 3 opens. You must review this matrix before you register, so you know which colleges and courses have seats available. bihar_raw_news.content: The Chief Minister chaired a review meeting at his official residence. (Pic Credit: @samrat4bjp/X) News Brief Bihar CM Directs Officials To Expedite Land Acquisition For Two Greenfield Airports Under State's New Land Purchase Policy By Arjun Brij Published: 29th Sep, 2026 at 12:50 PM Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Monday (28 September) directed state officials to accelerate work on two greenfield airport projects at Ajgaibinath Dham and Sonepur. The first phase of the Ajgaibinath Dham Greenfield Airport will require investments of Rs 3,500 crore, whilst the Sonepur Greenfield International Airport's initial phase will see Rs 6,500 crore invested under the public-private partnership mode. The Chief Minister chaired a review meeting at his official residence where officials presented techno-economic feasibility reports, traffic surveys, and master plans for both projects. Choudhary directed officials to expedite land acquisition procedures and complete all necessary tasks in a time-bound manner through mutual coordination under the Bihar Raiyoti Land Purchase Policy, 2026. The airport will provide improved air travel facilities to Munger, Lakhisarai, Jamui, Bhagalpur, Banka, Khagaria, and Begusarai districts, and will facilitate the movement of pilgrims arriving from various parts of the country during the Shravani Mela. The Sonepur project received special attention during the review, with emphasis on cargo facilities and passenger connectivity. The proposed Sonepur airport is expected to provide air connectivity benefits to 22 districts of Bihar, alongside neighbouring districts in Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh. The certificates were handed over to the Andhra Pradesh Forest Development Corporation and a bamboo farmer from Odisha. Indian Forest and Wood Certification Scheme The Indian Forest and Wood Certification Scheme was launched in December 2023 by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. The scheme is branded as PRAMAAN, which is used for certification of forest and wood-based value chains in India. PRAMAAN is linked with sustainable forest management, agroforestry, and responsible practices in wood-based industries. The scheme is also aligned with the National Working Plan Code 2023 and international market requirements such as the European Union Deforestation Regulation. Types of Certification under PRAMAAN The scheme provides three certification categories. Forest Management Certification applies to forests and plantations managed under approved standards. Trees Outside Forests Management Certification applies to trees grown outside recorded forest areas, including farm forestry and agroforestry systems. Chain of Custody Management Certification applies to tracking certified material through processing and trade. Andhra Pradesh is set to become the first state to receive PRAMAAN certification for environmentally sustainable cultivation practices. The certification process covered about 33,000 hectares

bihar_raw_news.content: English News National Flood Alert: 8 Rivers In Spate In UP, Bihar Schools Closed | Latest News Chhattisgarh’s Indravati river breaks 53-year water-level record: 833 rescued by boats and helicopters; Rajasthan hit by hail, UP blanketed by winter-like fog New Delhi 11 hours ago Copy link The water level of the Indravati River in Chhattisgarh’s Bastar district rose to 12.39 metres after heavy rainfall triggered by Cyclone Arnab, breaking a 53-year-old record. The river level surpassed the previous record of 12.18 metres, recorded on July 9, 1973, by 21 cm. Several low-lying areas of Jagdalpur have been inundated, with drone visuals showing extensive flooding in residential areas. Authorities launched rescue operations as the water level continued to rise. On Monday, 833 people were evacuated to safer locations. As many as 65 relief camps have been set up across the district, where 8,894 flood-affected people are currently staying. Rajasthan sees rain, hail as western disturbance brings weather change Several parts of Rajasthan, including Jaipur, Bikaner and Churu, received rain accompanied by hail due to the impact of a western disturbance. The sudden change in weather brought cooler nights, with the minimum temperature in the Shekhawati region falling below 20°C. The weather department has forecast a rise of 3–4°C in temperatures over the next two to three days. Dense fog blankets parts of UP in September Parts of Uttar Pradesh witnessed dense fog on Tuesday morning, with Amethi, Rampur and Badaun reporting significantly reduced visibility. Visibility dropped to around 25 metres in some areas, while residents also experienced a slight chill. The September fog comes as the southwest monsoon has begun withdrawing from the state. The monsoon has already retreated from parts of western Uttar Pradesh, including Muzaffarnagar and Aligarh. With its withdrawal, heavy rainfall has subsided across the state. bihar_raw_news.content: Advertorial Banwarilal Chandiwala takes silver shopping beyond Bihar, from malls to wheels Spotlight Wire Synopsis Banwarilal Chandiwala is expanding beyond Bihar through an all-India franchise model, with three franchises finalised, while its Jewellery on Wheels mobile showroom brings its silver retail offering to customers in Patna and supports wider expansion. By Spotlight Wire Last Updated: Sep 29, 2026, 08:40:00 PM IST Follow us Banwarilal Chandiwala , one of India’s largest hallmark silver jewellery malls , is rapidly expanding beyond Bihar and moving towards establishing its presence across the country. The brand has now initiated its national expansion under its All-India Franchise Model , marking a new phase in its retail journey. ADVERTISEMENT The expansion is designed to take the brand's silver retail experience to customers in more cities while creating opportunities for franchise partners across India. With its focus on hallmark silver jewellery and a wider collection of silver products, Banwarilal Chandiwala is positioning itself around an organised, contemporary approach to silver retail. Three franchises finalised, more cities identified A key highlight of this expansion is that three franchises have already been finalised. At the same time, major cities across Bihar, including Boring Road in Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur, Darbhanga, Purnia, Ara, Begusarai, Katihar, Munger, Chhapra and Samastipu r , along with other prominent cities across India, have been identified for franchise expansion, the brand said. The proposed expansion reflects the brand’s intention to build a wider retail network while retaining the identity and product focus that originated in Bihar. The franchise model is expected to help bring Banwarilal Chandiwala’s silver jewellery and premium silver offerings closer to customers in different markets. “Jewellery on wheels” As part of this expansion and innovation journey, the brand has also launched “Jewellery on Wheels.”The concept introduces a mobile showroom format, allowing customers to experience jewellery shopping beyond a conventional fixed retail location. Bihar creates a world-first — India’s first luxury jewellery experience on wheels The brand says customers can now enjoy a unique shopping experience featuring silver jewellery and premium silver products , both at the grand Banwarilal Chandiwala Mall and aboard the Jewellery on Wheels bus. The concept brings together jewellery, mobility, and luxury retail, creating a new-age retail experience. ADVERTISEMENT Currently, the Jewellery on Wheels concept is operational in Patna, while the brand has also begun offering franchise opportunities. As the franchise network grows, the concept is intended to support the brand’s wider expansion and potentially bring the mobile jewellery experience to more cities across India. A complete silver retail experience The Banwarilal Chandiwala mall offers an extensive collection of premium silver products, including hallmark silver jewellery, artefacts, gifting items, decorative pieces and silver furniture. The broader product offering is designed to demonstrate the versatility of silver beyond traditional jewellery, covering gifting, décor and lifestyle categories as well. national_raw_news.content: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar said that India’s relationship with China is better today than it was last year. Speaking at an event organised by Asia Society in New York, Dr Jaishankar said the relationship started improving once the border standoff was resolved. He said that India has long been telling China that a dip in bilateral relationship does not help either country and a long standoff does not serve the interests of any nation. Speaking about the India-US relationship, and the trade deal negotiations, the External Affairs Minister said both nations have reached a situation where there is an understanding on the trade agreement. He pointed out that India is a society of small producers, small agriculture producers, and small factories. He added that apart from the per capita gap between India and the US, the nature of production and the nature of society are very different. He said a trade negotiation required a certain amount of patience and detailing to see it through. He admitted that tariffs did create a bump for the relationship last year. Dr Jaishankar also highlighted the issue of terrorism, saying it is a particularly important issue for India. He remarked that there is not enough understanding or empathy from the US side regarding that. The External Affairs Minister stated that the Russia-Ukraine and the Iran-Gulf conflicts had a devastating impact on Global South economies. He expressed concern about the energy situation, saying the market is very tight. He further stated that if people play politics with it, it adds to the market complications and drives up prices at a time when people should be stabilising prices. He also cautioned that there is likelihood of a major food crisis, and significant fertiliser shortages, in the coming months.

national_raw_news.title: Neeru Dhanda becomes first Indian shooter to win Asian Games gold in women’s trap 4 hours ago 98
national_raw_news.content: In the Asian Games 2026, Neeru Dhanda has made history by becoming the first Indian shooter to win a gold medal in the women’s trap individual event. This came after she carried India to a silver medal in the women’s trap team event with Aashima Ahlawat and Manisha Keer. The Indian trio finished with a combined score of 328 points to secure the silver, finishing three points ahead of Kuwait, who took bronze with 325. China won the gold medal with a score of 346. In Boxing, Parveen Hooda and Ankush Panghal have stormed into the gold medal bouts of their respective weight categories with semifinal wins at Nishio today. Parveen defeated China’s Li Shu 5-0 in the 65kg semifinal, before Ankush came from behind to out-punch reigning 75kg world champion Uzbekistan’s Fazliddin Erkinboev 4-1 to book his place in the 80kg summit clash. In athletics, India secured a double podium finish in the men’s javelin throw. Yashvir Singh won the silver medal with a personal-best effort of 85.72 metres, while Rohit Yadav claimed bronze with a throw of 84.35 metres. In the men’s long jump, Sreeshankar Murali secured the silver medal with a best effort of 8.07 metres. Gulveer Singh also added another silver to his tally after finishing runner-up in the men’s 1,500 metres. He had earlier won silver in the men’s 10,000 metres. In shooting, Esha Singh won silver in the women’s 25-metre pistol individual event. The 21-year-old Indian shooter finished second with a score of 38 points. India has moved up to 11th place in the 2026 Asian Games standings, bringing its total medal tally to 47. The current tally includes 5 gold, 21 silver, and 21 bronze medals. President Droupadi Murmu has congratulated Neeru Dhanda, Aashima Ahlawat and Manisha Keer on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s Trap Team event at the Asian Games 2026. In a social media post, the President said that their precision and steady focus have brought this success. President Murmu has wished them to continue to keep their sights set on many more memorable achievements.
